name: alotofimaginarches
description: Interactive funicular and line-of-thrust analysis of masonry arches, in the browser
author: Giovanni Castellazzi <giovanni.castellazzi@unibo.it> (DICAM, University of Bologna)
comment: There are no dependencies and there is no build step, on purpose.
docs/app is plain ES modules, served as-is by GitHub Pages, so the
source a student reads is the source that runs. This file exists only
so that Node knows the .js files are modules, to name the test command,
and to offer `npm start`, which is node:http and nothing else.
The test script passes no path on purpose. `node --test tests/*.test.js`
relies on the SHELL to expand the glob, which cmd.exe does not do, so
every Windows runner received the pattern as a literal filename and the
job failed while macOS and Linux passed. With no path Node walks the
working directory for its own naming conventions, and `tests/*.test.js`
